definition.title: Describe changes of state with direction forms
definition.subtitle: Learn, understand, and use a Mandarin pattern.
definition.context: Use the introduced pattern in a bounded sentence. Other wording may be valid Chinese; this task checks this pattern and these words.

steps.title: Describe changes of state with direction forms

blocks.text: Directional forms can describe changes of state: 下来 settles, 下去 continues, 起来 begins, and 过来/过去 can describe recovery or loss of awareness. Interpret the whole predicate in context. 过去 after a sleep or loss-of-consciousness predicate can mark losing awareness, not literal movement away. Contrast this with motion past a location.

examples.pinyin: tā tài lèi ， jiù shuì guòqù le 。
examples.meaning: He was so tired that he drifted off to sleep.

examples.text: 他从学校门口走过去了。
examples.pinyin: tā cóng xuéxiào ménkǒu zǒu guòqù le 。
examples.meaning: He walked past the school entrance, away from the speaker.
